title: Request artist information
description: Filter pending submissions, request a specific update and verify the decision history.

steps.caption: 1. Filter the review queue to pending submissions and choose the artist.
2. Read the artist's story, then write a specific request in the decision panel.

target.label: Message to artist (required when requesting information)

actions.value: Please add your next radio date and the show name.

steps.caption: 3. Request more information notifies the artist and lets them resubmit their answers.
4. Choose the more-information status to find the submission again and read its decision history.
